targetText: It still remains for us, incidentally, to investigate the problem of turnover.
explanation: Capital turnover time consists of production time plus circulation time; reducing turnover time accelerates the annual rate of profit accumulation.

targetText: Suppose his fixed capital has to be renewed in 10 years.
explanation: Fixed capital transfers its value gradually over multiple production cycles (e.g. factory machinery), while circulating capital transfers its entire value in a single cycle (raw materials/wages).

targetText: But this demand is equal to v and not one iota greater (if the labourer saves a part of his wages ; we necessarily discard here all credit relations ; he converts part of his wages into a hoard and to that extent does not act as a bidder, a purchaser).
explanation: Hoarding money capital is a necessary phase under capitalism to accumulate sufficient reserves before purchasing large fixed assets or expanding production.
Social reproduction requires continuous exchange between Department I and Department II to balance industrial equipment needs with consumer wage goods.
